global_conventions.simulator: stratlab.sim with the round-5 optional fields (Entry.exit_sig / bracket, Swing.exit_fn / lots): exits by rule at the next bar's (session's) open as market orders with slippage; an opposite entry decided on the same bar fills at that same open
global_conventions.intraday: intraday MIS; decisions at candle close, fill next 1-min open; 15:15 square-off; Rs 1 lakh per trade; NIFTY-100 universe (~97 names); 2 bps slippage (5 bps sensitivity)
global_conventions.algotest: NIFTY index future (underlying NIFTY, 1 lot = 65, spot index as the future), 5-minute candles; 50-pt stop / 100-pt target from the fill; opposite signal reverses (Pine strategy.entry, pyramiding 0); intraday 15:15 square-off (holding unspecified); 1 bps index slippage
global_conventions.algobulls: AlgoBulls code defaults (_config.yaml); talib formulas; crossover = last two candles, values rounded to 2 dp (CROSSOVER_ACCURACY_DECIMALS 2); per candle the framework processes exits before entries, so an exit by an opposite crossover is followed by the opposite entry on the same candle (stop-and-reverse); intraday square-off; whole NIFTY-100 universe instead of the single default stock
global_conventions.indicators: stratlab.kite_ind (platform formulas) on continuous candle series with the short last candle kept (stratlab.kite_tf)

entries.name: Varsity price-momentum portfolio

published_rule.entry: Universe of about 150-200 stocks (e.g. Nifty 50 / BSE 500). At the close of the last trading day of the month, rank by 12-month return (end/start - 1). Buy the top 12 (10-12 is allowed; the example uses 12) on the first trading day of the month.
published_rule.exit: At the monthly rebalance, sell names that drop out of the top N and buy the new entrants
published_rule.notes: Equal weight is the base case. Variants (fortnightly or weekly rebalance, fundamental momentum) are mentioned. The author notes it works poorly in sideways or falling markets.

defaults_fixed_before_any_run.universe: factor_momentum's: 2013-23 point-in-time top-100 by turnover (delisted kept); 2023-26 current ~97 NIFTY-100 names (survivorship-biased)
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.ranking: C[t]/C[t-252]-1 at the month's last close, top 12
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.rebalance: names staying in the top 12 are not re-weighted; cash from the sales is split equally among the entrants
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.gates: factor_momentum.judge: each era-1 half CAGR > 0 and > NIFTY, era-1 Sharpe >= 0.5, era-2 CAGR > 0 and > NIFTY

entries.name: Varsity pair trade (regression residual, PTM2)

published_rule.entry: Regress Y on X and use the residual's z-score. Long pair (buy Y, sell X) at -2 SD; short pair (sell Y, buy X) at +2 SD
published_rule.holding: until reversion; freeze the regression equation while the trade is open
published_rule.notes: Hedge ratio = slope (beta). The pair filter is a low error ratio (SE of intercept / SE). The ADF p-value cutoff appears only in comments (0.05 or 0.1). The regression lookback is unspecified. Some traders use 2.5 SD (comment).

defaults_fixed_before_any_run.pairs: same NSE industry (ind_nifty500list.csv), both with stock futures that day, both in the month's top-100 (2012-23)
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.adf: statsmodels adfuller default (constant, AIC lags), p < 0.05, on the 200 residuals at the entry decision
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.entry: 2 <= |z| < 3 at the close, both legs at the next open, beta > 0 required
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.exit: z crosses 0 (frozen regression), stop |z| >= 3, at the next open
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.sizing: Rs 1 lakh of Y, round(beta * qty_Y) shares of X
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.prices: adjusted cash prices with futures costs (lab stock-futures convention)

entries.name: Varsity pair trade (price ratio density, PTM1)

published_rule.entry: Ratio A/B; density-curve value 0.025-0.003 = long ratio (buy A, sell B); 0.975-0.997 = short ratio (sell A, buy B)
published_rule.exit: Position moves back inside 2 SD (short: density 0.975 or lower)
published_rule.stop_loss: long: density 0.003 or lower (the table's 'or higher' is an acknowledged typo); short: 0.997 or higher
published_rule.notes: Lookback: the author suggests about 2 years in comments (the example uses about 496 days). Rupee neutrality is intended but not implemented in the example. The author calls the rules generic, and both worked trades entered outside the table's ranges.

defaults_fixed_before_any_run.density: normal CDF of the ratio vs its rolling mean / SD (recomputed daily)
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.long: enter 0.003 <= density <= 0.025, exit >= 0.025, stop <= 0.003 (acknowledged table typos resolved by symmetry with the short side)

entries.name: Varsity Bullish Marubozu

published_rule.entry: Open≈Low and Close≈High. Risk-taker buys near the close (3:20 PM check) on the pattern day; risk-averse buys at the next day's close if that day is bullish
published_rule.notes: Skip if the candle range (H-L)/C is below 1% or above 10%. Shadow tolerance about 0.2% (comment).

defaults_fixed_before_any_run.instrument: stock futures (simulated on the cash price, futures costs) for long and short patterns alike
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.tolerances: shadows 'tiny' / 'near' = <= 0.2 % of the close (Varsity author's marubozu tolerance); hammer/hanging man body <= 2 % of the open ('within 1-2 %'); long body = above the mean body of the previous 10 sessions, doji/spinning top = below it (lab candles.py reference); gaps = body gaps
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.holding: until stop or target (or the end of the simulated period)
